title: Direction-finding for some off-the-beaten-path quest destinations gave precise step counts (Sergeant Coe: 'west five stands from Camp Gallows to the Listening Break, then north twice') while others gave none (Captain Vane's 'west past the Waiting Bough' for the Hanged Company), leading to roughly 15 turns of undirected backtracking through an interconnected forest grid before finding it.
where: Thornwold / Captain Vane's Tent, 'propose the Company swear an oath'
